title: GPT-5.6 Sol Preview
hook: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model it says is stronger at coding, science, and cybersecurity — and shipped with its most advanced safety stack yet.
key_points: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, billed as a next-generation frontier model.
Headline gains are in coding, science, and cybersecurity.
OpenAI pairs the capability jump with what it calls its most advanced safety stack to date.
A preview, not a full release — details and benchmarks are limited at announcement.
content_html: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model it describes as notably stronger in coding, science, and cybersecurity — and paired with its most advanced safety stack so far.
extra_html:
What was announced

This is a preview rather than a general release, so concrete benchmarks are thin at announcement. OpenAI's framing is twofold: a step up in frontier capability — singling out coding, scientific reasoning, and cybersecurity — and a parallel investment in safety, which the company calls its most advanced safety stack to date.

Why it matters

Cybersecurity is an unusual capability to foreground: stronger models are dual-use, useful both for defenders and attackers, which is likely why OpenAI ties the announcement so tightly to safety. As frontier labs keep raising the ceiling, the pattern of shipping capability and safeguards together is worth watching. Details are in OpenAI's announcement, linked as the source.
